answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 11 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in zenith, checked in jetty, and vine reveals each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 3734 identities would post 1018 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
